facts.label: Soletrar e dar o endereço
facts.sub: Para soletrar, diga letra por letra, e para pedir, use Can you spell that, please? Para o endereço, use número + rua e Apartment + número ou letra.

facts.label: Carteirinha da biblioteca
facts.sub: Em muitas cidades dos EUA, moradores fazem a carteirinha de graça. Basta mostrar um documento com foto e um comprovante de endereço.

facts.label: Pegar emprestado
facts.sub: Com a carteirinha você pode pegar livros, filmes e audiolivros. O prazo costuma ser de três semanas, e muitas bibliotecas permitem renovar pela internet.

mini.pt: Pode {soletrar isso,|soletrar o seu nome,} por favor?

compare.br: In Brazil, you may need a comprovante de residência, and the card can be paid.
compare.us: In the USA, a public library card is often free with an ID and an address. Staff may ask you to spell names.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A public library card is usually free for residents.
You never need to give an address.
items.why: The library usually asks for one.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

pages.title: A card for Mei · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday afternoon at a public library in Seattle. Mei wants to read more books in English. She walks to the front desk and smiles at the librarian. “**Hello! I’d like to sign up for a card,**” she says.
“**Sure. What’s your last name?**” asks the librarian. “It’s Oliveira,” says Mei. “**Can you spell that, please?**” “**O-L-I-V-E-I-R-A,**” she says slowly.

pages.title: A card for Mei · 2/3
paragraphs: The librarian types the letters on the computer. “**Thank you. What’s your address?**” “**Two twenty-one Pine Street,**” says Mei. “**Which apartment?**” “**Apartment four B.**”
Mei looks at the form and checks every line. “Is Pine spelled P-I-N-E?” she asks. “Yes, that’s right,” says the librarian. “**Go slowly, because I want to write it correctly,**” says Mei.

pages.title: A card for Mei · 3/3
paragraphs: In five minutes, the card is ready. “You can borrow ten books for three weeks,” says the librarian. Mei chooses two books about Seattle. “Thank you! See you next week,” she says. She walks out of the library with her new card and a big smile.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: As vogais do alfabeto inglês são diferentes das do português: A soa “êi”, E soa “i” e I soa “ai”.
pages.how: Diga A como “êi”, E como “i” longo e I como “ai”. Pratique O-L-I-V-E-I-R-A devagar: “ou-él-ai-vi-i-ai-ar-êi”.
